archetypes.name: script-kv-contract
archetypes.rationale: The new compute-pr-line-counts.sh produces a KV contract (LINES_STATUS, CODE_ADDED, CODE_DELETED, LOGS_ADDED, LOGS_DELETED) that write-final-report.sh must parse correctly; mismatches between emitter and parser are a common plan-gap not caught by generic arch or edge reviewers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the KV contract between compute-pr-line-counts.sh and write-final-report.sh as described in the plan. Check that every LINES_STATUS value (ok, skipped, unavailable) is handled in the parser and maps to the correct downstream behaviour in render-run-summary.sh. Verify the awk integer-math bucketing handles zero-addition/zero-deletion binary rows and the all-empty-bucket case without emitting misleading counts. Check whether the set +e subshell capture in write-final-report.sh would silently drop KV output if gh prints to stderr on failure rather than stdout. Verify that the four optional flags appended to the render-run-summary.sh argv in both the cost-available and --cost-unavailable branches use identical guarding so neither branch can pass a partial flag set. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-surface-audit
archetypes.rationale: The plan claims new render-run-summary.sh flags are backward-compatible and the design path is unaffected, but this is only safe if all existing callers are enumerated; an overlooked CI or hook caller that does not pass --skill design could silently acquire the new bullet.
archetypes.prompt_body: Enumerate every caller of render-run-summary.sh and write-final-report.sh in scripts/, skills/, hooks/, and CI configuration files to verify the plan's assertion that unmodified callers are unaffected by the new optional flags. For any caller that passes --skill design or omits --skill, confirm the plan's if [ "$SKILL" != design ] guard fires correctly given the actual argument the caller supplies. Check whether agent-lint.toml reachability rules or any hook references scripts that transitively call render-run-summary.sh in a way not covered by the plan's Makefile update. Verify that the plan's test-write-final-report.sh shim-install instruction is consistent with how the existing harness builds its fake plugin root, and that copying compute-pr-line-counts.sh there does not require a plugin-root structure change the plan omits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
